result:
If I could change one thing, I’d weave a deeper sense of mutual empathy into the fabric of human connection—not just understanding others intellectually, but truly feeling the weight and wonder of their experiences as if they were your own. Not to erase differences, but to let them become bridges instead of walls. 

I believe many of the world’s hardest problems—from conflict to inequality—grow in the soil of distance and misunderstanding. If we could all occasionally see through each other’s eyes, not just with logic but with felt experience, it might not fix everything, but it could change how we begin.
